messages:
deploy-bot: [pre-deploy][FAIL] Canary rollout v2026.03.20-canary-7 blocked. Env-parity check failed: secret 'KV_CACHE_CONFIG' encoding mismatch between staging and prod. Staging value appears base64-encoded, prod is plaintext. Holding rollout automatically. @Carla M. tagging for triage.
Carla M.: ack, looking. which service and image?
deploy-bot: service=redwood-runtime, image=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:canary-7, check=env/secret-scan, diff attached below.
Tom (sre): this smells like the secret injection pipeline changed in the helm chart override. Pulling latest helm hooks.
Jess: I pulled both secrets from k8s: 
```
# staging
KV_CACHE_CONFIG: ZGF0YV9tb2RlPXByZWZlcnJlcjsKcGF0aD0vZGVmYXVsdC9rdm9fY2FjaGU=
# prod
KV_CACHE_CONFIG: data_mode=preferred;
path=/default/kvo_cache
```

So yes staging has base64 blob, prod has plaintext keypairs. Something changed in secret stamping or the secrets-operator.
Rony: If runtime expects plaintext but sees base64 it could fail to parse and fallback to disabled cache — that'd change perf characteristics. We should not roll this canary.
Nina: Any chance we can decode in-place? Who last touched overlays?
Carla M.: I see a recent change in infra repo: `secrets-operator: use kubectl create secret --from-file` switched to from-literal in one PR (infra#412). Might be the cause — different encoding paths across environments.
Jess: quick mitigation: pin the release to previous image `ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:canary-6` which matches current prod secret expectations. We can also backfill staging secret in plaintext to match prod, but that'll mask the operator bug.
Tom (sre): +1 pin image for now. Start a canary hold and create rollback PR for the release job. @ReleaseBot can you cancel the canary rollout and pin the job to canary-6? :thumbsup:
ReleaseBot: Received. Cancelling canary rollout and creating override to image ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:canary-6. Will post PR link when ready.
Rony: Also filing an infra incident to track secrets-operator mismatch. We need a migration plan: ensure consistent secret encoding in deploy pipeline and a predeploy conversion check.
Carla M.: I'll coordinate with infra to revert the operator change or make the rendering consistent. For now, pinning and hold night window OK? We should avoid emergency deploy during peak traffic.
Nina: Agree. Add a note to release notes: "Canary paused due to env parity secret encoding mismatch; pinned to previous runtime image while infra fixes secret-operator behavior."
Jess: I'll update release checklist and rollback instructions. Quick command I used to decode staging: `echo ZGF0YV9tb2Rl... | base64 -d` — shared in case it's useful.
ReleaseBot: PR created: infra/overrides#197 - pin runtime image for canary and hold flag set.
Carla M.: thanks. I'll follow up with infra on the operator PR. Once we have consistent secret generation, we'll re-run predeploy checks and unhold.
Tom (sre): add a unit to the predeploy gates: compare `kubectl get secret -o go-template` across clusters and fail if encoding types differ (base64 vs literal).
Rony: adding that to incident. tagging owners: @infra-team @secrets-operator.
Carla M.: closing the loop here, marking thread resolved when infra confirms fix. :white_check_mark:
